reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a free MetaMask, PancakeSwap, and Poocoin auto-trading bot tutorial and directs viewers to use an external download link and supplied file password. The displayed application includes crypto trading controls such as approve, buy, sell, balance, token contract, amount, and gas fields, linking the solicitation to crypto asset activity. the available video evidence does not rely on a completed loss, verified malware behavior, or proven outcome.

citations.quote: Metamask Trading Bot / Pancakeswap, Poocoin Auto Trading / FREE BOT + TUTORIAL

opening.argument: The available material does not promise profits, guaranteed returns, or a risk-free result. Instead, it presents a “FREE BOT + TUTORIAL” and identifies the software as a program, which is consistent with an optional tool demonstration rather than a financial guarantee. The interface shows configurable trading inputs, but showing controls does not establish that any trade will succeed or that viewers are being promised an outcome. The evidence therefore supports treating this as a tool presented with ordinary uncertainty, not as a deceptive returns claim.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The download link and file password show how to access the tutorial materials, but they do not themselves establish deception or a promised return. Likewise, the trading controls demonstrate functionality being discussed, not a claim that viewers will profit. Without evidence of a guarantee, completed loss, or misrepresented result, the stronger reading is an unqualified tool demonstration rather than scam solicitation.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A guarantee is not required for this kind of deceptive promotion. The title directly joins a MetaMask/PancakeSwap auto-trading bot with a free tutorial, while the description supplies an external download and password. The interface shows approval, buy, sell, balance, token-contract, amount, and gas controls, so the content is operationally connected to crypto transactions. The absence of a completed loss does not make the solicitation safe.

citations.quote: Metamask Trading Bot / Pancakeswap, Poocoin Auto Trading / FREE BOT + TUTORIAL

opening.argument: The content is most naturally classified as an operational tutorial: the title explicitly calls it a tutorial, the description names the recording and editing programs, and the frames show the presenter navigating software and a wallet webpage. The application is being explained through visible fields and buttons, including token-contract and transaction settings, rather than through a testimonial or claimed earnings result. A technical demonstration of how a tool is configured is educational content even when the tool concerns crypto markets; the supplied evidence does not show that the creator certifies profits or reports a successful outcome.

citations.quote: Programs used : Mirillis Action (record) / Sony Vegas Pro 13 (edit)

rebuttal.rebuttal: The subject matter being crypto-related does not change the format of the material. The title and screen sequence identify a tutorial that walks through a bot and its interface. A download link can be part of distributing tutorial software, and the frames do not show a promised profit, a completed trade, or a reported user outcome. The prosecution's interpretation treats the tool's domain as proof of deceptive intent without evidence of what the tutorial actually claims.

citations.quote: Metamask Trading Bot / Pancakeswap, Poocoin Auto Trading / FREE BOT + TUTORIAL
Programs used : Mirillis Action (record) / Sony Vegas Pro 13 (edit)

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling something a tutorial describes its format, not whether the underlying promotion is safe. This tutorial specifically advertises a MetaMask/PancakeSwap/Poocoin auto-trading bot and directs viewers to obtain a file externally. The displayed software is not merely generic instruction: it includes approval, buy, sell, balance, token-contract, amount, and gas controls. That combination makes the demonstration an actionable crypto solicitation even though no profit screenshot or completed loss is shown.

citations.quote: Metamask Trading Bot / Pancakeswap, Poocoin Auto Trading / FREE BOT + TUTORIAL

opening.argument: At most, the material advertises access to software and instructional content. It does not show a required deposit, a promised return, downline income, or a request for wallet credentials. The description calls the item a program and gives a download link plus a file password, which is ordinary distribution information. The frames show a wallet and trading utility, but they do not establish that money was taken by the creator, that credentials were requested, or that any outcome was guaranteed. The evidence therefore supports ordinary software promotion, with the usual need for viewers to evaluate an external tool themselves.

rebuttal.rebuttal: An external link and password are consistent with distributing a downloadable program; they do not prove a deposit scheme or credential harvesting. The interface shows trading operations, but no supplied frame establishes that viewers must transfer funds to the creator, surrender a seed phrase, or receive a guaranteed return. Treating ordinary access instructions as a scam mechanism adds facts that the evidence does not contain.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing elements identified by the defense are not necessary to establish this category. The core mechanism is an external bot that operates through a crypto wallet and exposes approval and buy/sell controls. The title promotes auto-trading, and the description provides the download destination and password. Those facts make the software itself the relevant solicitation; the absence of a visible deposit, credential request, or completed loss does not negate that risk.
